Exercise: Barbell Rollout from Bench

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- horizontal_pushing

Primary Muscles:

- abdominals

Secondary Muscles:

- glutes
- hamstrings
- lats
- shoulders

Equipment:

- barbell

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- core_strength_and_stability
- abdominal_hypertrophy

Contraindications:

- Lower back pain
- Shoulder instability

Exercise Variations:

- name: Barbell Rollout from Floor, equipment: barbell
- name: Resistance Band Rollout, equipment: resistance band

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Cable Woodchop, equipment: cable machine
- exercise_name: Kettlebell Rollout, equipment: kettlebell

Instructions:

- Place a loaded barbell on the ground, near the end of a bench. Kneel with both legs on the bench, and take a medium to narrow grip on the barbell. This will be your starting position.
- To begin, extend through the hips to slowly roll the bar forward. As you roll out, flex the shoulder to roll the bar above your head. Ensure that your arms remain extended throughout the movement.
- When the bar has been moved as far forward as possible, return to the starting position.
